controls: For each of the two morning training windows, average the frozen original neural natural posterior and that window same-day tree natural posterior at fixed 50/50 weight. Apply the same three policies to the same five dates and two assets. Forecast-marginal priors must be recomputed from each mixture, not inherited from one component.
interpretation: This is additional development analysis on exposed dates. It changes no model fitting or selection, adds no independent evidence, and cannot close the discovery gate.
matched_comparisons: Compare every adapted neural to the original neural; each adapted-neural/original-tree blend to the original blend; and each adapted-neural/morning-tree blend to the original-neural/same-morning-tree blend, always with the same decision policy.
reason: Before morning fitting or assessment-score inspection, add matched unadapted-neural plus same-day-tree controls. They distinguish gains from fine-tuning the neural model from gains already supplied by a fresher tree.
